description: This file defines interfaces and functions related to local storage payloads, including encrypted, decrypted, and deleted payloads, for a data management system. It includes type guards, payload creation functions, and references to external modules.

methods.name: isEncryptedLocalStoragePayload
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a payload is an encrypted local storage payload.

methods.name: CreateEncryptedLocalStorageContextPayload
methods.description: Creates an encrypted local storage payload from an encrypted payload interface.

methods.name: CreateDecryptedLocalStorageContextPayload
methods.description: Creates a decrypted local storage payload from a decrypted payload interface.

methods.name: CreateDeletedLocalStorageContextPayload
methods.description: Creates a deleted local storage payload from a deleted payload interface.
